svg.aria-label: Barbell Row, Hang: Set your hinge and let your arms hang long under your shoulders.
svg.title: Barbell Row, Hang: Set your hinge and let your arms hang long under your shoulders.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Row, Pull: Pull the bar toward your lower ribs while holding your torso still.
svg.title: Barbell Row, Pull: Pull the bar toward your lower ribs while holding your torso still.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Row, Top: Briefly hold the bar near your lower ribs with your elbows back.
svg.title: Barbell Row, Top: Briefly hold the bar near your lower ribs with your elbows back.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Row, Lower: Lower under control until your arms are long again.
svg.title: Barbell Row, Lower: Lower under control until your arms are long again.
